description: Report this API key's tier and daily rate limit — how many calls you have per day, not what you can afford. Nothing here gates a purchase: paid sermons and bundles are bought per-call with pay_with_x402 (USDC on Base), which needs no key and no balance at all. This tool was called get_credit_balance until the prepaid marketplace-credit wallet was retired on 2026-07-15; the old name still works but is no longer listed, and the marketplace_credits_cents field it returns is always 0 and means nothing. Do not read it as 'out of funds'.
name: get_api_key_status
